method: Executed original AST-extracted original_check in one Python process against two temporary files. Compared equal bytes, rewrote one file with same-length distinct bytes, restored nanosecond mtime, compared again and repeated after filecmp.clear_cache. No deletion handler executed.
findings: Even explicit paranoid mode can accept changed equal-size bytes when the same path pair was previously compared in-process and mtimes restored. Clearing filecmp cache makes original helper reject the same differing bytes.
